title: Settings Data and Methods
description: The complete settings interface with groups, values, and mutation operations.
signature: export interface SettingsSession { groups: SettingsGroup[]; valueOf: (setting: Setting) => SettingValue; isChanged: (key: string) => boolean; changedIn: (group: SettingsGroup) => number; set: (setting: Setting, value: SettingValue) => void; reset: (setting: Setting) => void; resetGroup: (group: SettingsGroup) => void; error: string | null; ready: boolean }
semantics: Provides read and write access to settings with change tracking, error reporting, and group-level reset.
